principle: Every observed workflow is mapped; safe patterns become KJDS-native modules, unsafe patterns remain explicit rejected alternatives.

capabilities.observed: Browser extension download and unpacked installation guidance
capabilities.kjds_target: Browser Capture Inbox helper distribution
capabilities.boundary: signed/reviewed package, minimal permissions, no implicit background capture

capabilities.observed: Ozon seller account and API-key shop authorization
capabilities.kjds_target: Connector Registry + tenant/entity/store credential vault binding
capabilities.boundary: official Seller API, least-role key, IP allowlist, revocation and Evidence

capabilities.observed: Plugin binds Ozon shop Cookie state
capabilities.kjds_target: No equivalent; official API or authorized export only
capabilities.boundary: never transfer cookies/localStorage/session state

capabilities.observed: Manual and automatic shop-information synchronization
capabilities.kjds_target: Store-scoped read runs, cursors, scheduler, raw Evidence and drift queue
capabilities.boundary: read-only first; writes require independent Approval/Permit/Readback

capabilities.observed: Copy an Ozon product and list it to one or more stores
capabilities.kjds_target: PIM ListingPlan batch diff and governed publish command
capabilities.boundary: no copying protected content; downside CM3, Passport, QA, Approval and one-time Permit per frozen batch

capabilities.observed: Edit copied listing, AI text, image beautification, translation and resolution
capabilities.kjds_target: Versioned Russian content draft + media studio + factual/IP QA
capabilities.boundary: Passport/Evidence inputs, no competitor copy, candidate-only generation, independent approval

capabilities.observed: Collect 1688, Taobao and Pinduoduo products for Ozon listing
capabilities.kjds_target: Provider-neutral Browser Capture Inbox and admitted source adapters
capabilities.boundary: allowed current-page observation only; no cookies, internal APIs, CAPTCHA bypass or fact promotion

capabilities.observed: Copy product-page images
capabilities.kjds_target: Media reference capture + rights review + owned delivery manifest
capabilities.boundary: external image stays unverified reference until rights Evidence; never copy competitor assets into a listing

capabilities.observed: Redraw an existing product image with AI
capabilities.kjds_target: Media workbench controlled image variant job
capabilities.boundary: rights, product fidelity, color/structure/OCR QA, model/version/cost lineage

capabilities.observed: Generate main images and rich-content image suites with an image model
capabilities.kjds_target: Template catalog + batch image execution + partial failure/retry + manifest
capabilities.boundary: provider-neutral model adapter; no provider claim becomes quality Evidence

capabilities.observed: Add inventory to one or many products
capabilities.kjds_target: Inventory ledger, warehouse availability, batch diff and controlled stock command
capabilities.boundary: initial Pilot 1-3 units; no entitlement may bypass learning/readback/settlement gates

capabilities.observed: Batch add, change or remove products from promotions
capabilities.kjds_target: Promotion experiment plan, profit floor, bounded batch command and compensation
capabilities.boundary: price-index target cannot break downside CM3; Approval/Permit/Readback required

capabilities.observed: Cross-border pricing tool and profit calculator
capabilities.kjds_target: Fifteen-item Decimal CM3 kernel, price lab and settlement reconciliation
capabilities.boundary: estimated, accrued, settled and cash contribution books remain separate

capabilities.observed: Shop data-analysis workspace
capabilities.kjds_target: Scoped BI semantic layer, market radar and operating anomaly center
capabilities.boundary: official fields or explicit proxy/no_data; never infer sales from reviews

capabilities.observed: Bind multiple store Cookie sessions
capabilities.kjds_target: Independent store identities, RBAC, credential vault and store matrix
capabilities.boundary: no shared cookies or cross-store credential reuse

capabilities.observed: View product listing status
capabilities.kjds_target: Listing lifecycle projection, platform receipt and independent readback
capabilities.boundary: HTTP success is not completion; state requires readback Evidence

capabilities.observed: Repair image, country and non-copyable product problems
capabilities.kjds_target: Typed listing exception queue, root cause, owner/SLA and deterministic retry
capabilities.boundary: repair must not remove compliance controls or fabricate category/country data

capabilities.observed: Create, preview and bind different watermark templates per store
capabilities.kjds_target: Rights-aware brand overlay templates and store-scoped render manifests
capabilities.boundary: platform image rules, rights and readability QA; no misleading or contact information

capabilities.observed: Configure selection rules and label qualifying product cards
capabilities.kjds_target: Versioned OpportunityScorer and explanation badges
capabilities.boundary: server-owned score, exact cohort, full/downside economics and no invented demand

capabilities.observed: Automatically favorite qualifying items and batch-list them
capabilities.kjds_target: Candidate queue + approval allocation waitlist + frozen listing batch
capabilities.boundary: automatic candidate intake only; listing remains a separately approved external command

capabilities.observed: Automatically remove products from promotions
capabilities.kjds_target: Profit/quality stop policy proposing a compensating promotion command
capabilities.boundary: bounded policy, approval/permit, independent readback and rollback

capabilities.observed: Automated passport, pickup and review reminders
capabilities.kjds_target: Order/customer-service task templates with consent, locale and rate controls
capabilities.boundary: official messaging surface only; personal-data minimization and no manipulative review solicitation

capabilities.observed: Store data dashboard
capabilities.kjds_target: Server-observed operating cockpit + Agent status rail + Graph drilldown
capabilities.boundary: real observations, freshness and no_data; no synthetic GMV/orders/profit

capabilities.observed: Manage ERP access across multiple devices
capabilities.kjds_target: Session/device inventory, revocation, tenant RBAC, audit and enterprise SSO envelope
capabilities.boundary: no credential sharing; device/session revocation and least privilege

capabilities.observed: ERP introduction includes order management
capabilities.kjds_target: OMS order/return/cancellation/service timeline and sale-triggered procurement
capabilities.boundary: official order facts, idempotent events, no purchase until a real order and governed procurement decision

capabilities.observed: ERP introduction includes reverse topic-tag lookup
capabilities.kjds_target: Market Radar keyword/category/search visibility evidence
capabilities.boundary: official analytics or allowed observation; no private endpoint or fabricated search volume

capabilities.observed: Linked Ozon listing-error handling guidance
capabilities.kjds_target: Versioned error taxonomy, runbook, replay fixture and exception resolution Evidence
capabilities.boundary: rule/version/effective-date bound; never bypass platform validation

capabilities.observed: Common websites and tool-download directory
capabilities.kjds_target: Governed connector/tool catalog with license, provenance, permission and replacement review
capabilities.boundary: no unsigned/unreviewed binary or plugin receives business credentials or execution authority
